derivable.total_bytes: Derivable via state engine from raw flow fields: orig_bytes + resp_bytes
derivable.total_pkts: Derivable via state engine from raw flow fields: orig_pkts + resp_pkts
derivable.byte_rate: Derivable via state engine from raw flow fields: total_bytes / (duration + 1e-6)
derivable.pkt_rate: Derivable via state engine from raw flow fields: total_pkts / (duration + 1e-6)
derivable.avg_pkt_size: Derivable via state engine from raw flow fields: total_bytes / (total_pkts + 1.0)
derivable.is_new_edge: Derivable via state engine from raw flow fields: DeviceState.seen_edges
derivable.src_fanout_recent: Derivable via state engine from raw flow fields: DeviceState.recent_dst_ips
derivable.device_zscore: Derivable via state engine from raw flow fields: DeviceState.byte_rate_history
derivable.proto_tcp: Derivable from protocol field via one-hot encoder
derivable.proto_udp: Derivable from protocol field via one-hot encoder
derivable.proto_icmp: Derivable from protocol field via one-hot encoder
derivable.conn_state_sf: Derivable from connection state field via one-hot encoder
derivable.conn_state_s0: Derivable from connection state field via one-hot encoder
derivable.conn_state_rej: Derivable from connection state field via one-hot encoder
